description: This is a C source file implementing functions for localization file list management, including path construction, normalization, and linked list handling for localization files.

methods.name: _nl_make_l10nflist
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a linked list node representing a localization file, constructing its filename based on locale parameters and checking for existing entries.

methods.name: _nl_normalize_codeset
methods.description: Normalizes a codeset name to a standard form, returning a dynamically allocated string.
